title: Count the Number of Houses at a Certain Distance II
summary: Count ordered pairs of distinct houses by shortest-path distance. Houses 1 through n form a path; add an undirected edge between x and y. Return n counts, where output index k-1 counts pairs at distance k. x and y may coincide.
officialConstraints: 2 <= n <= 100000; x and y are house indices in 1..n.
pitfalls: Count both directions, not unordered pairs. Self-pairs are excluded. An O(n²) solver does not meet the full domain.
